description: Renovate baseline for the public intechcore repositories. The common part lives in grigoriev/renovate-config; rules for intechcore only go here.

packageRules.description: The JDK in the workflows follows maven.compiler.release and the Java runtime of the product, not the newest release. Moving the JDK is a decision, not an automatic update, and with automerge on it would otherwise land on its own.
